title: Myth Flip — 'I'm just a bad sleeper now' (Nisha, 44 · CBT-I)
caption:
Myth: bad sleep at 44 is just stress. First-line care for chronic insomnia is CBT-I, not a pill (ACP 2016).
Which myth should we flip next? 👇
www.aiforheratx.org
#perimenopause #insomnia #cbti #womenshealth #sleephealth #menopausesupport

phrases: She started to think she was making it up.

scenes.text: Tonight: a 10-minute worry list at 8 PM. Still awake at 20 minutes? Leave the bed.
phrases: 8 PM: ten minutes, worry list, on paper.
Awake past 20 minutes? Get out of bed.
Tomorrow, a daylight walk. WHO's target is 150 minutes a week.
